criteria.contract: An explicitly arranged physical supplement to a known treaty supply request reaches its original supplier; the NPC signs an actual bounded stock-backed offer or a dated refusal and returns it to the original fixed address; no implicit mutation of old saves

The offer reserves real supplier house rice, sharing free-stock checks with salary, relief, procurement and military supply; the carrier personally opens the offer and physically collects it at the supplier site under the live giver authority

The same person carries supplier-owned cargo along ordinary travel routes and personally delivers partial quantities to the named recipient house; the actual local receiver authority, stock debit/credit, custody and cargo conservation are recorded without private resale or parallel cargo-capacity reuse

Expiry, treaty ending, physically delivered cancellation and authority changes stop new supply actions without teleporting already collected cargo; unspent supplier-owned rice returns physically, duplicate inputs cannot repeat a transfer, and returned stock does not revive an expired offer

Focused and relevant tests, actual generation recovery/future equality, old-save byte identity, Game build and actual headless Node3D positions verify the flow separately from appearance; verified code/docs are integrated autonomously under the user delegation

limits: 本人の受取手配による供与元の家の米・本人携行100kg上限・指定先の家への現地納入を対象とする。受取手配は元条約と14日以内、供与者の現権限/在席/同意/未引当在庫から数量を決める。一般NPC間の自律調達、代理輸送、海上軍用輸送、援軍の実出陣、通行軍の受入、違反裁定は後続。外観/GUI操作・全3758件は未実施。
